summary: Hines Global Income Trust filed an 8-K (Items 8.01/9.01) to publish its monthly net asset value update and the transaction price for its perpetual-life NAV REIT share classes effective November 1, 2026. The transaction price equals NAV per share by class as of September 30, 2026, with a comparison to August 31, 2026. A valuation committee of independent directors oversees the process; the advisor, HGIT Advisors LP, provides interim valuations reviewed by independent valuation advisor Altus Group, which concurred with the calculation. No transaction, stake, premium or board recommendation is present; the filing is routine NAV disclosure, not a special situation.
